question: Which exact 2024 cohort code should appear on the module 4 and 5 covers?

official_public_evidence.observation: A university news article identifies a participant as studying in ИСУ (KZ-US)-24-2. This supports the university group-code style but concerns the 24-2 cohort.
An official grant order lists students in ИСУ(KZ-US)-23-2. This supports the parenthesized KZ-US style, but concerns the 23-2 cohort.
Official educational-program passport confirms the Information Systems program under the Faculty of Engineering and Digital Technologies, but contains no student cohort roster.

finding: Public official sources support the style ИСУ(KZ-US)-year-cohort but do not establish whether this student belongs to 24-1, 24-1-1, or another section.
decision: Unresolved; do not alter report covers without a current official roster, enrollment record, or approved cover template.
confidence: high for naming pattern; insufficient for exact individual cohort
